scope: Test-only changes; integration includes core. No production code, fsync, authorization policy, timer defaults, build tags or fixture concurrency limit changed.

timing.method: Sequential existing test binaries, -count=1, integration tag; compilation excluded; same four fixture slots. Three samples explain calendar fixture/I/O variance. Final samples start after disk remediation, without overlapping test/build jobs.

pre_remediation_observations.note: Early runs happened around a linker no-space failure. Not used for the final comparison. One initial wrapper attempted t.Parallel within synctest; fixed by keeping four-slot admission outside the bubble.

environment_remediation.checks: Only >24h old Go archives containing the TeamX Room package, with verified inode/mtime/size and no lsof users; previous batch compiled test executables also removed after lsof inspection. Logs, source snapshots, user workspace and the rest of the Go cache retained.

remaining_room_cost_observation.note: Go JSON event-span observation, not CPU or I/O profiling. Current full run did not demonstrate whole-suite speedup.
